```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue"))
params <-
list(seurat_integrated = "./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds",  
    sample_name = "DE_ASPC", contrast = c("ASPC-HFSC", "ASPC-Chow"
    ), sig_genes_alpha = 0.1, output_dir = "./DE_ASPC", results_dir = "./DE_ASPC")

gg_color_hue <- function(n) {
  hues = seq(15, 375, length = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}

packages = c("tidyverse","Seurat", "AnnotationHub", "janitor",
             "reshape", "DT","cowplot","patchwork","forcats")

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
```

# Directory paths
```{r path}
data_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "data", Sys.Date())
results_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "results", Sys.Date(),
                         paste(params$contrast,collapse="_vs_"))
invisible(mapply(
    FUN = dir.create,
    list(data_dir,results_dir),
    MoreArgs = list(recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
))
```

# Load data
```{r load_data}
seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS(params$seurat_integrated)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"

DT::datatable(as.matrix(table(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster)), colnames = c("cell type", "number of cells"))
DT::datatable(as.matrix(table(seurat.combined.sct$DE_group)), colnames = c("cell type", "number of cells"))

```

# Find Marker in HFSC_vs_Chow
```{r Find_Marker}
getwd()
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct) <- "RNA"
seurat.combined.sct <- NormalizeData(seurat.combined.sct, assay = "RNA")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "DE_group"
seurat.combined.sct <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct)
markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.combined.sct, ident.1 = params$contrast[1],
                       ident.2 = params$contrast[2])
# saveRDS(markers, file = file.path(data_dir, paste(params$sample_name,"-","markers.rds")))


# markers <- readRDS("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg\ Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue/DE_ASPC/data/2024-07-17/DE_ASPC\markers.rds")

markers_df <- markers %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj)
head(markers_df)
# rio::export(markers_df, file = file.path(results_dir,paste0("DE_results_", paste(params$contrast, collapse = "_vs_"),".csv")))
markers_df_sig <- markers_df %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= params$sig_genes_alpha)
# rio::export(markers_df_sig, file = file.path(results_dir,paste0("DE_results_", paste(params$contrast, collapse = "_vs_"), "_sig_",params$sig_genes_alpha, ".csv")))
```

## Marker Plot
```{r Marker_plot}
markers_df_sig = markers_df_sig[!grepl('mt-',markers_df_sig$gene),,drop=F]
markers_df_sig = markers_df_sig[order(markers_df_sig$p_val, decreasing = F),]
markers.to.plot <- markers_df_sig$gene[1:20]

DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct) <- "SCT"
seurat.combined.sct$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(seurat.combined.sct$seurat_clusters)
seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster <- as.factor(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster)

for( gene in markers.to.plot){
  if(gene %in% rownames(seurat.combined.sct)){
  cat("### ",gene, "\n")
  cat("**Contrast** \n")
  png(filename = sprintf('./DE_ASPC/fig_Contrast/markers_%s.png', gene), width=8,height=15,units="in",res=100)
    p1 <- VlnPlot(seurat.combined.sct, 
                  features = gene,
         pt.size = 0.1,
        idents = params$contrast) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1))
  print(p1)
  dev.off()
  cat("\n")
  cat("**All groups** \n")
  png(filename = sprintf('./DE_ASPC/fig_allgroup/markers_%s.png', gene), width=12,height=8,units="in",res=100)
      p2 <- VlnPlot(seurat.combined.sct, features = gene,
         pt.size = 0.1) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1))+
        scale_x_discrete(limits = c("ASPC-Chow","ASPC-HFSC","B cell-Chow","B cell-HFSC","Dendritic cell-Chow","Dendritic cell-HFSC","EC-Chow","EC-HFSC","Macrophage-Chow","Macrophage-HFSC","Mesothelium-Chow","Mesothelium-HFSC","Neutrophil-Chow","Neutrophil-HFSC","Pericyte-Chow","Pericyte-HFSC","T cell-Chow","T cell-HFSC"))
  print(p2)
  dev.off()
    cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
  }
  else{
    cat("### ",gene, " \n")
    cat("Not present in dataset \n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

```
